headline: Flamerion Build
title: Flamerion Build | Phantom Barrage Refills EP | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Flamerion is a Fire energy unit, the final form of Sparki, and it only comes out at night. Trick Fire Ring adds Fire Debuff stacks on enemies. Then Phantom Barrage hits them and restores EP for each stack. In a fire team, it refills a teammate's EP after the break phase. Held items matter little here, so use spare gear. Do you run Flamerion? Comment below!
description: Flamerion build in Aniimo: Fire energy unit, Trick Fire Ring then Phantom Barrage to restore EP, best in a fire team. Appears only at night; Sparki evolves at level 21.
joke: Flamerion is basically a campfire that hands out snacks.
